target_kind.description: Selects strict scientific routing. Protein campaigns use SolubleMPNN/ProteinMPNN; small-molecule campaigns use LASErMPNN/LigandMPNN.

contig.description: Do not supply this for protein de novo. It remains recognizable only so Studio can return a direct migration error; the planner rejects it and derives the pinned MLX adapter's canonical binder-first contig from lengths and inspected target chains.

binding_site_mode.description: Optional for protein de-novo placement. If omitted with no hotspot/ORI, Studio resolves to surface_scan: multiple solvent-accessible outward ORIs with the exact design quota divided among them, never target COM. surface_patch positions near a broad region without hotspot conditioning; targeted_epitope requires explicit hotspot conditions; manual requires ori_token.

surface_patch_residues.description: Broad target region used only to calculate an outward ORI. These residues are never converted to hotspots.

infer_ori_strategy.description: Legacy/expert Foundry control. Do not use target COM for a fixed protein.

sequence_model.description: Default to solublempnn for soluble protein-protein binders. proteinmpnn is the alternative for protein targets. lasermpnn and ligandmpnn are only for small-molecule interfaces.

run_affinity.description: Small-molecule Boltz affinity head only; never use as a protein-protein binding score.

run_apo.description: For protein binders, independently predict the binder alone and compare it with its bound conformation.

extra_predictors.description: Independent verification engines. For protein binders choose at least one; Boltz is the normal first verifier. Every generated candidate is predicted before ranking.
